rules: This manifest describes dependencies, not permission to execute arbitrary commands.
Only the three ENUMERATION_JOB tools run from the domain form. CLI_ONLY stages are separate manual typed stages; the entire DAG is not an executable runner.
Every boundary canonicalises, deduplicates and filters to the exact domain or its subdomains; archive URLs are candidates, not evidence of a live service.
Preserve query strings and source/run provenance; remove fragments. Keep DNS names as targets, without implicitly authorising their IPs or CNAME destinations.
All target HTTP producers require governed egress (#44), including redirects, retries and auxiliary connections. Installation or a proxy flag cannot unlock them.
Newly discovered domains and URLs do not expand Burp scope. Import requires a separate current-scope check. AI findings remain unverified candidates.

tools.name: subfinder
tools.detail: All sources supporting recursive queries; bounded provider profile.

tools.name: chaos-client (chaos)
tools.detail: Chaos dataset; installed executable is chaos; PDCP_API_KEY/config.

tools.name: amass
tools.detail: Pin a version, verify passive-only behaviour and adapt structured output before execution; do not assume historical flags match installed versions.

tools.name: dnsx
tools.detail: Existing typed reconctl run profile: A/AAAA/CNAME, no implicit IP scanning. Not launched by this form.

tools.name: httpx
tools.detail: IP, technology, CNAME, TLS, server, title, status, length, location, timing; no automatic redirects or target-expanding TLS/CSP probing in saved plan.

tools.name: whatweb
tools.detail: Complementary fingerprinting; even aggression level 1 sends target HTTP and follows redirects. Needs governed transport plus report adapter.

tools.name: Waybackpy
tools.detail: CDX/availability reads only. Exclude SavePageNow: requesting a new capture can cause target fetching.

tools.name: waybackurls
tools.detail: Historical URLs from providers; pin invocation, provider access and URL adapter.

tools.name: urlfinder
tools.detail: Passive multi-source URL discovery; pin profile, provider limits and JSONL adapter.

tools.name: katana
tools.detail: Active crawler; existing output adapter/profile remains blocked at process boundary.

tools.name: gospider
tools.detail: Active crawler with JavaScript/link discovery; archive-source options do not make subsequent requests passive. Needs output adapter.

tools.name: cariddi
tools.detail: Crawler/endpoint/secret discovery; never execute through a provider-only exception.

tools.name: local canonicalise / dedupe
tools.detail: Merge as a union, allowing archive-only candidates when live stages are blocked; preserve queries and provenance, filter scope before any later fetch.

tools.name: JSFinder
tools.detail: Live URL/JavaScript retrieval requires governed transport and a pinned endpoint adapter. Existing captured JS can instead be reviewed locally in AI analysis.

stages.output: unverified candidate report + manual PoC suggestions

tools.name: existing five-agent evidence review
tools.detail: Select/redact evidence and preview provider sharing in AI analysis/Agent team; no automatic provider submission or PoC execution from recon.
